overrides.note: Gordon&Scott 2009/Flood 2013/Shiu 2024: sugar GRN -> SEZ IN (Fdg/Rattle/IN1) -> MN9 (PER). No direct GRN->MN9 synapses; no Fdg/Rattle type in male-cns. Model GNG015/DNge062/GNG095 as the premotor layer; sim may boost the excitatory leg

GNG015 (GABA 0.82) provides the strongest GRN-reachable input to MN9 (478) and MN8; sign-inhibitory per NT, plausibly feeding inhibition/rhythm of PER cycle; ACh route via DNge062 (556) not reached from BM_Taste at weight>=50. Review sign before sim
Glu prediction (0.72) in CNS interneuron treated as inhibitory (-1); in Drosophila Glu on cholinergic targets via GluCl is inhibitory
strong GRN-GRN lateral connectivity (2020 syn); keep, not literature-verified

sizeEstimate.threshold: extended = types (<=100 neurons) with summed synapse weight >=200 (either direction) to core set (BM_Taste + 8 SEZ interneurons + 6 DNge/DNg + MN9/6/8/11D/11V/12D) + forced claw_tpGRN, dorsal_tpGRN; BM_InOm (745) excluded by size; edges type-level weight>=50

openQuestions: No Gr5a/Gr64f-typed neurons: BM_Taste (40, labellar/ MxLbN taste, ACh) is used as best available sensory input; sugar vs bitter/water/salt subset not resolved in male-cns types
Fdg, Rattle, G2N, IN1 not typed in male-cns; names unresolved (DNge062 -> MN9 556 and GNG015 -> MN9 478 are candidate analogues, unverified)
ISN (4 neurons) found but connects to DNd01/PRW/AstA1, not sugar/MN9 path; excluded from core (likely not the Shiu IN1)
Male-cns motor naming: MN9 (2), MN6 (2), MN8 (2), MN11D/V, MN12D present; MN9 NT prediction unclear (0.49) so sign 0; ACh confs 0.55-0.68 for MN6/8/11/12 are below 0.6 for some -> sign 0
Strongest GRN-reachable MN9 premotor input GNG015 is GABA -> net sign of sugar->PER via connectome alone is ambiguous; excitatory route likely via DNge062 or unobserved Fdg-like cells
BM_InOm (745, pharyngeal/inner mouth sensory, ACh) excluded for size; pharyngeal sugar GRNs may live there; claw/dorsal tpGRN are taste-peg (Mx) GRNs kept as extended
